Finite numerical section probes supplement, not substitute for, infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural two-point positive-measure matrix, already studied for sharp norm and positivity, exhibits a complete signed essential spectral interval and an abrupt strong-operator midpoint collapse. This classifies the location of infinitely many negative approximate spectral modes rather than merely finding one negative principal minor, providing a structural functional-analytic explanation via translation asymptotics.
